## Recall · The data sheet and the report

a) You corrected a number in the table. What do you do to the PivotTable?
b) Where do you add a table of contents?
c) You add a heading after the contents. What do you press?

::: {.answer}
a) Refresh it.
b) References › Table of Contents
c) Update Table
:::

## Recall · The slides and the AI use

a) You changed a total in Excel. Which check do you do again on the slides?
b) Which four parts does an AI-use statement have?
c) Where does the statement of the project go?

::: {.answer}
a) accuracy
b) the tool, the use, the changes and the checks
c) at the end of the report, and a short line on slide 5
:::

## Summary

- The final data sheet: a clean table, a refreshed PivotTable and one chart with a real title.
- The final report: five headings, a table of contents, page numbers and checked numbers.
- Under What I learned: one change that you made after your talk.
- The four checks again on every slide after your changes.
- One AI-use statement for the whole project, and a short line on slide 5.
